title: List active Entra role assignments with role and principal names
summary: Inventory who holds which Microsoft Entra role right now (permanent or activated), the first step before moving admins to eligible PIM assignments.
code:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'RoleManagement.Read.Directory'

$role = @{}
Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -All | ForEach-Object { $role[$_.Id] = $_.DisplayName }

Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleAssignment -All -ExpandProperty principal |
  Select-Object @{n='Role';e={ $role[$_.RoleDefinitionId] }},
    @{n='Principal';e={ $_.Principal.AdditionalProperties.displayName }},
    @{n='UPN';e={ $_.Principal.AdditionalProperties.userPrincipalName }},
    @{n='Type';e={ $_.Principal.AdditionalProperties.'@odata.type' }},
    DirectoryScopeId |
  Sort-Object Role, Principal | Format-Table -AutoSize
notes: Shows active assignments only. PIM-eligible assignments that aren't activated don't appear here.
DirectoryScopeId '/' means tenant-wide; anything else is scoped (for example an administrative unit).

source.label: PIM: least privilege without breaking daily operations
